label: ElevenLabs Access
description: Connect ElevenLabs for the project's audio AI calls: pick the built-in connection, or bring your own ElevenLabs API key. Wire the access output into every ElevenLabs node; one connection, picked once, however many calls consume it.

permissions.label: Voice creation
permissions.description: Clone or design voices. A minted voice lives in the connected account and counts against its voice slots.

steps: Voices you clone or design land in the connected ElevenLabs account, so these nodes need your own account (any paid tier adds voice slots).
Nothing to pre-create: connect your own API key and the Clone Voice / Design Voice nodes mint voices straight into your Voice Lab.
Manage or delete minted voices at elevenlabs.io/app/voice-lab.

permissions.label: Voice agents
permissions.description: Phone/voice agents: the agents, their phone numbers, and their call history live in the connected account.

steps: Agents, phone numbers, and conversations live in the connected ElevenLabs account, so the agent nodes need your own account.
Create an agent at elevenlabs.io/app/agents (or with the Create Agent node) and give it a voice, a prompt, and a first message.
For phone calls, import a number under Agents > Phone Numbers (Twilio or a SIP trunk) and assign it to the agent.
Optional: design or clone a custom voice first (Voice creation above) and pick it as the agent's voice.
Open elevenlabs.io, Settings > API Keys, and create an API key.
Paste it below and name the connection.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: The ElevenLabs access: wire it into an ElevenLabs node's account input.
